intentEvidence: An interactive Mandala Chart plugin for Obsidian — the 9×9 goal-planning framework popularized by baseball star Shohei Ohtani.
motivation: Inspired by the Mandala Chart planning method, made famous by Shohei Ohtani's high school goal-setting chart.
problem: It provides a structured, visual framework for breaking down main goals into supporting ideas and actionable items.
summary: An interactive 9x9 Mandala Chart plugin for structured goal planning, inspired by Shohei Ohtani's method, supporting multiple languages and print export.
